source: TrustLensAI_ReinforcementLearning_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Reinforcement RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Reinforcement Learning pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: episodes/timesteps, sample efficiency, convergence, update stability
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: hard/soft constraint satisfaction, violations, safe-action verdicts
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance
